title: カラスと水さし (Karasu to Mizusashi / The Crow and the Pitcher)
description: A thirsty crow finds a pitcher of water with the level too low to reach. After failing to tip it over, the crow drops pebbles in one by one until the water rises high enough to drink. A lesson in patience and problem-solving. One of the WK community's top picks for absolute beginners.
author: Aesop (adapted by NPO多言語多読)
